newsitem.title: UK: Toyota considers 1 bln stg French plant-FT.
newsitem.headline: Toyota considers 1 bln stg French plant-FT.

text.p: Japanese car giant Toyota Motor Corp is considering building a one billion stg car plant in northern France, the Financial Times said.
The paper said the plant was likely to be set up in Lens and would help Toyota to boost its European sales by 50 percent by 2000.
The company's directors are expected to meet on May 10 to decide on the project which would create more than 2,000 new jobs.
The paper said Toyota has already been in touch with component and tooling suppliers and was likely to commence operations by the end of the decade.
The plant would have an initial capacity of 100,000 vehicles a year.
